examples.explanation: The three triples of distinct digits 1-9 summing to 9.
The smallest sum of four distinct digits is 10, so nothing qualifies.

hints: Grow each candidate one digit at a time, only choosing digits larger than the last one to keep selections ordered.
Abandon a branch once the running sum exceeds n or too few digits remain to reach size k.
Record a copy of the current pick as soon as its size is k and its sum is n.
title: 333. Combination Sum III
